description: The design-source render oracle wiring (exit criterion E7, guardrail G-11). Each frame maps a committed reference-painter golden to the design source it must render within tolerance of — Figma's REST GET /images export — and the per-rule tolerance band that governs the diff. The harness and the bands live in goldens/tooling/src/oracle.rs; the diff runs in goldens/tooling/tests/render_oracle.rs (the_reference_renders_match_their_design_source, #[ignore]-gated on #265).

gate.reason: The real design-source images (Figma REST GET /images exports for the corpus frames) are authored manually and tracked by the parked manual-Figma-authoring issue #265. No design source may be fabricated or stood in for by the project's own render — that is the self-oracle fidelity failure G-11 forbids. Until #265 lands, every frame's designSource is null and its status is pending-265; the render-oracle CI job reports each pending frame, never a silent green, and E7 stays open (docs/specification/05-qualification.md).
